title: Polite rejection
subject: Thank you for reaching out
content:
Hi {{name}},

thank you for your message about {{topic}}.
Unfortunately, I cannot take this on right now.

I do not want to commit to something I cannot deliver well and on time.
If helpful, I can recommend an alternative.

Thanks for understanding,
{{sender_name}}
ai_prompt: Write a polite rejection email to {{name}} about {{topic}}. Be warm and empathetic. Explain you cannot commit right now without over-explaining. Offer to recommend someone else. Keep it under 80 words.
